name: dsh-org-talent
description: Organization-wide employee matching in the DSH left sidebar: project progress with embedded outcomes and alerts, product acceptance and duplicate-development guards; editable talent profiles and drag-to-team org chart; one best team match with a persistent base team that adds only necessary members; one-paste feedback parsing; desktop memo; requirement pool; per-project DSH conversations; capability advice and skill research. · 左侧栏的组织人才匹配：项目进度内嵌成果与预警、产品验收与重复开发拦截；人才库可编辑、组织架构支持拖拽调队；匹配只给一组最佳团队，并可配置基础团队，缺能力时才新增；粘贴反馈智能拆分、桌面备忘录、需求池、项目对话与培养建议。
